note.i: Diploma Maximiliani Cā-poduncense, confirmans fœdus O-stergoum.
Foedus novum cum Westergois, Ostergoo fœderi simile.

page.notes: The marginal note block is set in italic and is given as one note beside the line "ab eo impetravit". Printed hyphens at line ends in the note are kept. "XXIII" in the date is uncertain and marked. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The marginal note in the left margin reads "Foedus novum cum Westergois, Ostergoo fœderi fimile." The "fimile" is printed as "fimile" and corrected here to "simile" as the probable intended word. The printed text has "Grogenfium" and "diffenfio" with long s, which are normalised to plain s. The year "M. cccc. XCVI." appears as printed, with the stop after the M and the final stop after XCVI.
